sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the opposite party no. 2 after matrimonial dispute has filed a complaint under Section 12Prevention of Women from Domestic Violence Act,
2005against the applicants, which is pending adjudication since the year 2021.

Learned counsel has referred to the FIR dated 28th May, 2025 to contend that on the said date, when the applicants had gone to attend the date of hearing before the court at Aligarh, the opposite party no. 2 at the instance of her lawyer friend assaulted the applicants, whereupon the above FIR has been registered, and two persons, applicant nos. 1 and 2 had suffered injuries, and in this regard, he has drawn the attention of the Court to the MLR (at pages 109 and 111).
He prays that the case be transferred to any other court of competent jurisdiction near District Aligarh.

Learned counsel has further submitted that on 28th May, 2025, an application was given before the trial court in respect of this incident, but no action/order has been passed on the said application by the trial court.

Upon hearing the learned counsel and considering his submissions, this Court does not find any merit in the application, as according to the application dated 28th May, 2025, the alleged incident took place outside the court room at around 02:10 pm, but the order dated 28th May, 2025 passed by the trial court simply adjourned the case for cross-examination of the witness.
There is no reference that any such application is filed by the applicants.

The case is pending for the last four years, and prior to the incident dated 28th May, 2025, no untoward incident had taken place with the applicants, and the stand of the applicants that the assault was suggested by a lawyer friend of the opposite party no. 2 is not supported with any material.
Therefore, this Court is not inclined to transfer the subject case.
The applications fail and are hereby dismissed.
Order Date :- 9.7.2025
Brijesh  Smt. Neelam Chandra And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 July, 2025
